briefdescription.para: Destroys all the remaining nodes in the treeset.

detaileddescription.para:
> Note: call only after thread join, or after all threads finished accessing the treeset.
tree
address of the treeset_t object.

briefdescription.para: Attempts to insert an element with a given key and value into the treeset.

parameterdescription.para: value to be associated with inserted key.
out parameter for the previous value associated with the key.

simplesect.para: false operation failed, since the given key was already in the treeset, in the out_value the value of this element is returned.

briefdescription.para: Attempts to remove an element with a given key from the treeset.

parameterdescription.para: out parameter for the value associated with the key.

simplesect.para: true operation succeeded, in the out_value the value of the removed element is returned.
false operation failed, there is no element with the given key.

briefdescription.para: Searches the treeset for an element with a given key.

parameterdescription.para: the key to be searched for.
out parameter for the value associated with the key.

simplesect.para: true operation succeeded, in the out_value the value of the found element is returned.
false operation failed, there is no element with the given key.

briefdescription.para: Visits all elements in the treeset.

detaileddescription.para:
> Note: call only after thread join, or after all threads finished accessing the treeset.
tree
address of the treeset_t object.
visitor
address of the function to call on each element.
arg
the third argument to the visitor function.

briefdescription.para: This implementation of treeset uses balanced red-black tree (RB) and coarse-grained locking.

detaileddescription.para: Refer to treeset_bst_coarse.h for more general information about treeset.
